limitations: python: absolute imports are matched against every discovered src root (no per-file sys.path modelling); star imports, importlib-dynamic imports and bare `from . import x` are not resolved
workflow configurations are opaque hash-bound code units; config_schema checks a bounded YAML shape; no job, expression, shell or hosted execution proof
parser: comment/string-aware regex (AST-lite), not the TypeScript compiler; decorators with computed arguments, re-exports deeper than 6 hops and dynamic dispatch are not resolved
incremental build (manifest.incremental_from) not implemented in builder0; every build is a full rebuild
files of uncovered languages yield no nodes: (none)×9, .example×1, .sh×6, .sql×2
